areas.label: Types and call interfaces
areas.evidence: The changed access is immediately dominated by the full-value guard if (var_r9 <= 6), where var_r9 is u16. The guard does not truncate to u8. No call, assignment or address escape intervenes before the read, so every evaluated index is 0..6; short-circuit comparison with next does not modify it. All imports, increments, decrements and zero clamps were audited, including possible transient u16 wrap. The expression -(-(u32)var_r9+1)+1 uses defined unsigned modulo arithmetic and preserves the complete value before indexing. Existing finish callback argument packing is retained; private two-word/scoped aliases were not selected.
